How do I load Google Fonts correctly?
rows.answer:
To load Google Fonts correctly in your project, you can use the `@font-face` declaration in your HTML file. Here's how you can do it:

### Step-by-Step Guide:

1. **Download the Font File**: Visit [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/) and download the desired font file (e.g., `.woff`, `.woff2`, or `.ttf`).

2. **Add to Your HTML File**: Include the Google Fonts in your HTML file by adding a `<link>` tag with `rel="stylesheet"` and `href="fonts/your-font-name.css"`.

   ```html
   <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=YourFontName" rel="stylesheet">
   ```

3. **Use the Font in Your Code**: Once the font is linked, you can use it in your HTML, CSS, or JavaScript files by specifying the font family.

### Example:

If you're using a specific font like "Roboto", your code would look like this:

```html
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Roboto" rel="stylesheet">
```

### Example Code:

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>Google Fonts</title>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Roboto&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
</head>
<body>

<!-- Your HTML content here -->

</body>
</html>
```
